children.notes: everyone = 每个人，作主语时谓语动词用单数。
children.statement: 这句话是一个简单的问候语。
children.explanation: Hello, everyone! 常用于演讲或自我介绍的开场白。

children.text: I am very glad to introduce myself to you.
children.cn: 我很高兴向大家作自我介绍。
children.explanation: glad 是表达喜悦常用形容词。

children.text: My name is Li Hua and I am 13 years old.
children.statement: 这句话介绍了名字和年龄。
children.explanation: 年龄表达用数字加 years old。

children.text: I live in Beijing, China with my parents and we have a pet cat.
children.cn: 我和父母住在中国北京，我们有一只宠物猫。
children.notes: live in + 地点 = 住在某地；pet cat = 宠物猫
children.statement: 句中包含了居住地和宠物信息。
children.explanation: 介绍了家庭居住城市和宠物，使自我介绍更丰富真实。

children.text: My favourite colour is blue because it looks like the sea.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，因为它看起来像大海。
children.notes: favourite = 最喜欢的；colour = 颜色
children.statement: 这句话使用了 because 引导原因状语从句。
children.explanation: because 用于解释喜欢蓝色的原因。

children.text: I like reading books and often play basketball with my friends.
children.cn: 我喜欢读书，并且经常和我的朋友们一起打篮球。
children.notes: play basketball = 打篮球；with one's friends = 和朋友一起
children.statement: 这句话介绍了日常爱好与球类运动。
children.explanation: 球类运动前不加 the，play basketball 是固定搭配。

children.text: I hope we can be good friends.
children.cn: 我希望我们能成为好朋友。
children.statement: 这句话表达了交朋友的愿望。
children.explanation: 作为结尾句非常合适，呼应单元主题。

children.text: Hello everyone, I am more than happy to introduce myself to you all.
children.cn: 大家好，我非常高兴向大家作自我介绍。
children.notes: more than happy = 非常高兴
children.statement: 这句话使用了 'more than happy' 增强喜悦语气。
children.explanation: more than 意为“极其、非常”，比单纯用 very 更生动。

children.text: My name is Li Hua, a 13-year-old boy who is full of energy.
children.cn: 我叫李华，是一个充满活力的13岁男孩。
children.notes: a 13-year-old boy... 作同位语；who 引导定语从句
children.statement: 这句话使用了同位语和定语从句修饰，句式紧凑高级。
children.explanation: 同位语结合定语从句使个人介绍更加生动。

children.text: Currently, I live in Beijing with my parents and an adorable pet cat.
children.cn: 目前我和父母以及一只可爱的宠物猫一起住在北京。
children.notes: live in = 居住在；adorable = 极其可爱的
children.statement: 句中的 'adorable' 比 'cute' 更生动形象。
children.explanation: 运用了高级形容词描摹宠物形象。
children.keywords: live in, parents, adorable pet cat

children.text: When it comes to my favourite colour, blue is my top choice because it brings peace.
children.cn: 说到我最喜欢的颜色，蓝色是我的首选，因为它能带来平静。
children.notes: When it comes to = 当谈到...; top choice = 首选
children.statement: 句首使用了 'When it comes to' 引出话题。
children.explanation: When it comes to 能够使段落过渡更自然流畅。
children.keywords: When it comes to, favourite colour, top choice, because

children.text: In my free time, I enjoy reading books and playing basketball with friends.
children.cn: 在空闲时间里，我喜欢读书以及和朋友们一起打篮球。
children.notes: enjoy doing sth = 享受做某事
children.statement: enjoy 后面接动名词 reading 和 playing。
children.explanation: enjoy doing sth 是表达兴趣爱好的地道句型。
children.keywords: free time, enjoy reading, playing basketball

children.text: If you share similar interests, I hope we can become great friends.
children.cn: 如果你有相似的兴趣，我希望我们能成为好朋友。
children.statement: 这句话真诚地表达了结交新朋友的愿望。
children.explanation: 条件从句结合 become great friends 使结尾感情真挚。
